title: Modernize public site theme to match admin panel and ensure readable typography across all colors

requirements.text: Update the global design tokens and typography so the public site has a modern, professional look consistent with the admin panel, while keeping all styling driven by semantic Tailwind token colors (background/foreground/card/muted/accent/etc.) rather than hard-coded one-off colors.

quotes: make it look more modern and make sure themes and fonts and everything can be seen no mater the color make the website look more like a professional modern theme same as the admin panel make it more modern like professional theme.

acceptanceCriteria: Global styles are updated in frontend/src/index.css (and related Tailwind token usage) so primary UI surfaces use semantic tokens (bg-background, text-foreground, bg-card, text-muted-foreground, border-border, etc.).
Typography is standardized (body, headings, labels) with consistent font-family usage and a modern, professional scale across the public pages.
No public-facing components rely on hard-coded colors that reduce legibility (e.g., fixed chrome text on similarly bright backgrounds).

requirements.text: Ensure text and UI element contrast remains readable across theme/color combinations by auditing and adjusting foreground/background pairings for key components (buttons, inputs, cards, badges, nav/header, tabs/menus) and providing accessible defaults for both light and dark mode.

quotes: make sure themes and fonts and everything can be seen no mater the color

acceptanceCriteria: Primary text, muted text, borders, and interactive states remain clearly legible in light mode and dark mode.
Interactive states (hover/focus/active/disabled) remain readable and clearly distinguishable.
Focus indicators remain visible on all backgrounds (keyboard navigation).

requirements.text: Modernize the public-facing layout styling to match the admin panel’s professional feel (header, footer, and landing hero/sections), while keeping existing navigation and page content unchanged.

quotes: make the website look more like a professional modern theme same as the admin panel

acceptanceCriteria: Brand header (frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx), shell/footer (frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx), and landing page (frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx) have a cohesive modern/professional visual treatment (spacing, borders, surfaces, typography).
No routes, copy, or core behaviors change—this is a styling/theme modernization only.
The landing page remains responsive and visually consistent from mobile to desktop.

requirements.text: Align admin panel theme readability by validating each existing admin theme option (goth-black, silver-steel, white-luxury, deep-purple, fire-red) maintains readable text and UI contrast for admin panel components and theme switcher states.
acceptanceCriteria: Switching between all existing admin themes does not produce low-contrast text (e.g., labels, inputs, table text) or invisible borders.
Admin UI elements used throughout the admin panel keep consistent semantic token usage for backgrounds/foregrounds/borders so theme swaps remain predictable.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI sources must be composed, not edited).
Do not edit any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
nonGoals: Adding new backend features or changing any Motoko canister logic.
Changing app routes, authentication behavior, or admin permissions.
Adding new theme types beyond the existing admin themes unless explicitly requested.
